description: This file defines a service locator class for managing and initializing singleton instances of various services such as AuthService, ProductService, CartService, and OrderService. It handles the setup of these services, including creating an ApiClient with shared preferences and logging the process.

classes.name: ServiceLocator
classes.description: A class that provides static access and initialization for core services used throughout the application. It ensures singleton instances are properly set up before use.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: A static async method that initializes all service instances, including setting up shared preferences, creating the API client, and instantiating each service.
